identity.name: Sea-Dweller
identity.one_liner: The 43mm Sea-Dweller launched for the model's 50th anniversary in 2017 — the first in the line with a cyclops.

narrative.story: The 126600 marked fifty years of the Sea-Dweller by growing the case to 43mm, printing the model name in red as on the 1967 original, and — controversially — adding a cyclops over the date for the first time in the line. Caliber 3235, 1,220m rating, helium escape valve. The single-red dial links it deliberately to the double-red collectible era.
narrative.collector_notes: 2017-carded examples mark the anniversary year. The cyclops divides Sea-Dweller buyers; it also distinguishes the reference from the 116600 at a glance.
